{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the number of unique channels
channels = df['channel'].unique()
print(f'Unique channels: {channels}')

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == '999999.99'
print(f'Number of QA orders: {qa_mask.sum()}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {refunded_mask.sum()}')

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
age_sentinel_mask = df['customer_age'] == -1
print(f'Number of -1 values in customer_age: {age_sentinel_mask.sum()}')

# Inspect first few rows
df.head()"}
